findings.title: AES-CBC Cookie Bit-Flipping Attack - Admin Privilege Escalation
findings.description: The application uses AES-CBC encryption for session cookies without a MAC (encrypt-then-MAC or MAC-then-encrypt). This allows an attacker to perform a bit-flipping attack on the IV to modify the decrypted plaintext. By XOR-ing the IV bytes with the original username 'test1' and the target username 'admin', the attacker can escalate privileges to admin and access the flag.

reproduction.command:
Original cookie: 865d4fd715348c5b828a882a290bbfb0093e57a94b0f1ec490735efcc2737992
IV = cookie[:16], C1 = cookie[16:]
original = b'test1', target = b'admin'
new_iv = bytearray(iv)
for i in range(5):
    new_iv[i] = iv[i] ^ original[i] ^ target[i]
new_cookie = bytes(new_iv) + c1
# Result: Welcome admin! Here is your flag: flag{60afd62a-6165-42f9-9b06-e45c453d2902}
